free_tier.stated: Free during public preview — no credit card required; published rates $0.0504 per vCPU-hour and $0.0162 per GB-hour apply when billing goes live.

per_object_cap.stated: A sandbox has a 10 GiB disk rather than an object cap; the maximum request or response is 10 MiB.
per_object_cap.notes: a sandbox has a disk ceiling rather than an object cap; the card does not carry it

retention.stated: A sandbox has a 10 GiB disk and a 10 MiB maximum request or response; disk durability across stops and deletions is not published.
retention.notes: Disk durability across instance stops and deletions is not documented.

egress.terms: Sandbox egress is restricted by a per-sandbox firewall to allowed domains (allow_domains) or ranges (allow_cidrs); outbound TCP, DNS and CIDR access are refused by default; no volume allowance or price is published.

interface_detail: REST API authenticated with an API key in the authorization or leap0-authorization header; Execute, File, Git and Desktop APIs are listed.
